lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgAl₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-62m (No. 189) with a unit cell containing six atoms—three Al and three Mg—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both sites: each Al center has 12 geometric neighbors (6 Al, 6 Mg), while each Mg center has 12 neighbors (6 Al, 6 Mg), with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.91 to 3.19 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Al-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Al- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
